# OnTimeCheck

OnTimeCheck is a lookup tool showing historical on-time performance, delay causes, and cancellation rates by airline and by specific route, sourced from the U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics official Airline On-Time Performance data.

## Core value
Real government-reported performance instead of marketing claims. Updated monthly with a ~3 month reporting lag.

## Key pages
- Home: https://ontimecheck.calyvent.com/
- Pricing: https://ontimecheck.calyvent.com/pricing
- About: https://ontimecheck.calyvent.com/about
- Dashboard (auth required): https://ontimecheck.calyvent.com/dashboard

## Search
- By Airline: overall on-time %, cancellation rate, avg delay minutes, delay cause breakdown, 12-month trend
- By Route: origin-destination pair, per-airline stats, best/worst carrier

## Data source
BTS Airline On-Time Performance Monthly Reporting. Aggregated on import, not live API.
